name: Xanthic-Almagest
description: Water rules this world utterly, kilometers deep over drowned continents. Swells march in orderly regiments until they shatter against a tidally locked hemisphere, and the spray smells of minerals and cold salt.
Light is the weather here. It swings from merciful to murderous within an hour, and everyone schedules their lives around it. Ambush predators lie beneath the thermally warm silt, patient as geology.
Local legend among spacers says the planet hums on a frequency just below hearing. Instruments confirm it. Nobody agrees on the source.
Every syndicate scout files the same advice: harvest fast, land light, and never spend a full cycle planetside. The wise ones follow it exactly once.
